originality.rationale: The 2021 Ortega–Benet–Larralde work covers the antipodal spectral circle E²+γ²=4 and pinned states, so those are explicitly excluded from novelty. The submitted theorem establishes all interior defective strengths, algebraic and geometric multiplicities, first Jordan threshold 2sin(π/m), and polynomial amplification even with all-real energies. These do not follow from eigenvalues alone: Jordan structure requires geometric eigenspace analysis; the published discussion mentions endpoint EP γ=2 but no equivalent complete interior list or growth law. Broader transfer-matrix or PT literature could yet subsume the classification.

value.rationale: This is a natural dynamical completion of the much-studied antipodal PT ring spectrum: it identifies precisely when all-real energies nevertheless give unbounded time propagators. The first such parameter is finite-size dependent, 2sin(π/m)∼2π/m, despite the all-real spectral interval extending to strength2 at every size, and the endpoint Jordan order changes with parity. These distinctions matter to stability and cannot be inferred from reality of eigenvalues alone; the result is an exact all-cycle classification rather than arbitrary small numerical cases.
